author: Xbox
description:
Crimson Desert is now available as an Xbox Play Anywhere title on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud and it's handheld optimized!

Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Take on the role of the Greymane Kliff and embark on a journey across the continent to reclaim everything you've lost. Explore uncharted lands, encounter mysterious factions, and experience firsthand a world that is as breathtaking as it is merciless.

description:
Labyrinthian corridors. Raid-like puzzles. Seven frozen vaults leading to an entity even the UESC fears.

Cryo Archive awaits. Coming March 20, 2026.[NB1.1]

Your first chance to take on this new end-game zone aboard the derelict UESC Marathon ship starts this Friday, March 20 .

Scavenge the lost colony of Tau Ceti IV in Marathon, the survival extraction FPS from the creators of Halo and Destiny.

Play Now: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pb32dkqkzdq

Infil into the dark sci-fi world of Tau Ceti IV: A derelict colony rife with rival Runners, hostile UESC security forces, and unpredictable environments. Play with your crew, as a solo Runner, or form uneasy alliances with proximity chat. Scavenge, buildcraft, and take on greater PvPvE challenges with tense, first-person shooter gameplay.
